metadata.method_name: Bench route test of prompt bans (CRN KV-splice arms, one-shot veto, prefill) in Qwen3-8B
metadata.decoding: T=1.0, top-p 1.0, no top-k, max 1024 new tokens, CRN inverse-CDF sampling
metadata.hardware: 1 x NVIDIA L4 23 GB, 6 CPUs, 66 GB RAM
metadata.baselines: arm a (full ban) and arm b (token-length-matched neutral twin) in the same pipeline with the same uniforms; placebo splice and knockout-mechanics controls

mixed_glm.note: descriptive sensitivity (variational Bayes); logit-scale fixed effects at zero random effects

C2c.rule: SUPPORTED if hit fraction >= 2/3 AND rho < 0 with permutation p < 0.05; DISCONFIRMED if rho >= 0 or hit fraction < 1/2; else INCONCLUSIVE (committed in commit #1)

lp_readout.note: descriptive companion readout (teacher-forced log-prob of the default's signature prefix)

deviations.what: Hardware: one NVIDIA L4 (23 GB; about a third of the RTX 4090's memory bandwidth) instead of the planned RTX A4500. Measured decode latency was 89 ms/step at B=20 and 101 ms/step at B=40, so batches a...
deviations.consequence: Batch shape is constant within each shape class (task, cache length, first position); CRN partners of a slot always meet identical kernels (U1 = 1.00, U2 = 1.00).

deviations.what: Rows of different templates with equal prompt length share a batch (cross-template packing); the last batch of a class is padded with discarded duplicate rows.
deviations.consequence: None on the estimates; rows never interact inside a batch.

deviations.what: V1 (one-shot veto) runs at N=100 (k 0-19) instead of N=50; VP (persistent veto) at N=100 on the path screen; route arms c/d also run on non-gated tasks at N=100 (descriptive, Q5 upgraded).
deviations.consequence: More precision at no extra batch cost (B=40 pairs b with V1, a with c, etc.).
